content.text: Contraindicated with opioid analgesics or current opioid dependence (including methadone or buprenorphine maintenance), or acute opioid withdrawal; opioid-dependent patients, including those treated for alcohol dependence, should be opioid-free (including tramadol) before starting: at least 7 to 10 days after short-acting opioids.
